comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A 7-item Memorial Album related to Alchemy Transmutation, to be added in the Chapter 3.3 update, "Babylon". The items are:

Enkidu's Robe (R11 Alchemy/Sewing)
Starlight Gemstone x3 + Exquisite Velvet x10 + Ignis Solution x10 (2,000 Sophia)
MA Result: Enkidu's Robe

Enkidu Head (R11 Alchemy/Sewing)
Starlight Gemstone x3 + Platinum x10 + Ignis Solution x10 (2,000 Sophia)
MA Result: Enkidu Head

Babylonian Foot Soldier's Spear (R11 Alchemy/Casting)
Starlight Gemstone x5 + Seal of Salamander x5 + Terra Extract x10 (2,000 Sophia)
MA Result: Ancient Stone Sword

Lion Head (R11 Alchemy/Handicrafts)
Starlight Gemstone x3 + Ivory Work x10 + Ventus Reduction x10 (1,500 Sophia)
MA Result: Guardian Creature

Noble Wooden Paneling (R11 Alchemy/Handicrafts)
Starlight Gemstone x5 + Special Ship Paint x1 + Ventus Reduction x10 (1,900 Sophia)
MA Result: Special Vermilion Wooden Paneling

Noble Metal Paneling (R11 Alchemy/Handicrafts)
Starlight Gemstone x5 + Special Ship Paint x1 + Aqua Concentrate x10 (1,900 Sophia)
MA Result: Special Vermilion Metal Paneling

Ancient Civilization Decor 1 (R11 Alchemy/Handicrafts)
Starlight Gemstone x3 + Brick x30 + Aqua Concentrate x10 (1,500 Sophia)
MA Result: Ishtar Gate

To fully complete the Album, you need Starlight Gemstone x27 and 12,600 Sophia (plus everything else listed, of course).

MA Reward: Starry Hair Ornament
Receive from: Leo Africanus（Tunis）

As with all Legacy/Transmutation MAs, receiving the Album reward unlocks special nickname titles (which will be posted at a later date). Cheers, and great online voyaging to you.

Source: wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1342.html
